question: What are the best alternatives to the Baseus 100W USB-C cable?
query: best alternatives to Baseus 100W USB-C cable Anker UGREEN Belkin Cable Matters reviews specifications 2026

replays.text:
**Best like-for-like replacement: [Cable Matters 10Gbps USB-C to USB-C cable](https://www.macworld.com/article/2051607/usb-c-charging-cables-iphone-ipad-mac.html).** It supports **100W charging**, **10Gbps data transfer**, and **4K monitor output**—a strong pick if you want more than charging from your cable.

Other good choices:

- **[Ugreen Nexode Retractable 100W](https://www.macworld.com/article/2051607/usb-c-charging-cables-iphone-ipad-mac.html)** — Choose this if you want a compact, tangle-free retractable cable. The tradeoff: it’s not intended for monitor connections, and data transfer is slow.
- **[Anker 515 USB-C cable](https://www.macworld.com/article/2051607/usb-c-charging-cables-iphone-ipad-mac.html)** — A higher-performance option: up to **240W**, **20Gbps**, and **8K display support**. It’s more cable than you need if you only want a basic 100W charging replacement.

**My pick:** Cable Matters for the best balance of charging, data, and display support; Ugreen if retractability is the main reason you liked the Baseus. Check the exact listing for cable length and connector details before ordering.

If you mean the **Baseus 100W retractable cable**, these are the strongest alternatives:

- **[UGREEN Nexode Retractable USB-C Cable 100W](https://www.macworld.com/article/2051607/usb-c-charging-cables-iphone-ipad-mac.html)** — The closest match: retractable and rated for 100W. Best for tidy charging on the go; it’s **not suited to monitor connections** and has slower data transfer.
- **[Cable Matters 10Gbps USB-C to USB-C Cable](https://www.macworld.com/article/2051607/usb-c-charging-cables-iphone-ipad-mac.html)** — Better if you want more than charging: it supports **100W, 10Gbps data, and 4K monitor output**. It isn’t retractable.
- **[Anker 100W USB-C Cable](https://www.itechguides.com/which-premium-usb-c-cable-should-replace-anker-three-model-level-alternatives/)** — A straightforward option for charging phones and laptops, but the cited model **doesn’t support video output**.

**My pick:** UGREEN for a retractable, travel-friendly replacement; Cable Matters if you need data speed or display support. Check the exact listing’s specs and length before ordering, since USB-C cables with similar names can have different capabilities.

The best pick depends on whether you want a like-for-like retractable cable or better data/display performance:

- **Best overall: Cable Matters 10Gbps USB-C to USB-C** — supports **100W charging, 10Gbps data, and 4K monitor output**, so it’s the most capable option here if you don’t need the Baseus’s retractable design. ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/2051607/usb-c-charging-cables-iphone-ipad-mac.html))
- **Best retractable alternative: Ugreen Nexode Retractable 100W** — a close match for charging and tidy travel use. The trade-off: it’s **not suitable for monitor connections** and has slower data transfer. ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/2051607/usb-c-charging-cables-iphone-ipad-mac.html))
- **Best basic value: Anker 100W USB-C cable** — a straightforward charging-and-data option, but the cited listing says it **doesn’t support video output**. ([Anker cable details](https://www.itechguides.com/which-premium-usb-c-cable-should-replace-anker-three-model-level-alternatives/))

**My recommendation:** get the **Cable Matters** cable if you might connect a monitor or want faster transfers; choose the **Ugreen** if retractability is the main reason you like the Baseus. Check that your charger and device also support the charging speed you want.
